rawToolsCapture.name: session_show_defaults
rawToolsCapture.description: Show current active defaults. Required before your first build/run/test call in a session — do not assume defaults are configured.

rawToolsCapture.name: session_use_defaults_profile
rawToolsCapture.description: Switch the active session defaults profile.

profile.description: Activate a named session defaults profile (example: ios or watch).

global.description: Activate the global unnamed defaults profile.

rawToolsCapture.name: session_set_defaults
rawToolsCapture.description: Set session defaults for the active profile, or for a specified profile and make it active.

configuration.description: Build configuration for Xcode and SwiftPM tools (e.g. 'Debug' or 'Release').

simulatorName.description: Canonical, machine-portable simulator selector (safe to share via SCM); the background refresh re-resolves it to this machine’s UDID.

simulatorId.description: Machine-local simulator UDID, materialized from simulatorName when one is set; UDIDs are not portable across machines.

simulatorPlatform.description: Cached platform derived from the selected simulator’s runtime; must be cleared/recomputed whenever the simulator selector changes.

derivedDataPath.description: Default DerivedData path for Xcode build/test/clean tools.

preferXcodebuild.description: Prefer xcodebuild over incremental builds for Xcode build/test/clean tools.

platform.description: Default device platform for device tools (e.g. iOS, watchOS).

bundleId.description: Default bundle ID for launch/stop/log tools when working on a single app.

env.description: Default environment variables to pass to launched apps.

extraArgs.description: Default extra xcodebuild arguments for tools that accept extraArgs.

profile.description: Set defaults for this named profile and make it active for the current session.

createIfNotExists.description: Create the named profile if it does not exist. Defaults to false.

rawToolsCapture.name: session_clear_defaults
rawToolsCapture.description: Clear session defaults for the active profile or a specified profile.

profile.description: Clear defaults for this named profile instead of the active profile.

all.description: Clear all defaults across global and named profiles. Cannot be combined with keys/profile.

rawToolsCapture.name: list_sims
rawToolsCapture.description: List iOS simulators.

rawToolsCapture.name: boot_sim
rawToolsCapture.description: Boot iOS simulator for manual/non-build flows. Not required before simulator build-and-run (build_run_sim).

rawToolsCapture.name: open_sim
rawToolsCapture.description: Open the simulator frontend for visibility and manual workflows. Not required before simulator build-and-run (build_run_sim).

rawToolsCapture.name: build_sim
rawToolsCapture.description: Build for iOS sim (compile-only, no launch).

buildForTesting.description: Build reusable test products without running tests (default: false)

testProductsPath.description: Output path for the .xctestproducts bundle when buildForTesting is true

rawToolsCapture.name: build_run_sim
rawToolsCapture.description: Build, install, and launch on iOS Simulator, booting it when needed. Runtime logs are captured automatically and the log file path is included in the response. Preferred single-step run tool when defaults are set.

extraArgs.description: Additional xcodebuild/build-settings arguments (not app launch arguments)

launchArgs.description: Arguments passed to the launched app process on simulator runtime

rawToolsCapture.name: test_sim
rawToolsCapture.description: Test on iOS sim.

testProductsPath.description: Path to a prepared .xctestproducts package. Cannot be combined with source inputs

xctestrunPath.description: Path to a prepared .xctestrun file. Cannot be combined with source inputs

testRunnerEnv.description: Environment variables to pass to the test runner (TEST_RUNNER_ prefix added automatically)

progress.description: Show detailed test progress output (MCP defaults to true, CLI defaults to false)

rawToolsCapture.name: get_sim_app_path
rawToolsCapture.description: Get sim built app path.

rawToolsCapture.name: install_app_sim
rawToolsCapture.description: Install app on sim.

appPath.description: Path to the .app bundle to install

rawToolsCapture.name: launch_app_sim
rawToolsCapture.description: Launch app on simulator. Runtime logs are captured automatically and the log file path is included in the response.

launchArgs.description: Arguments passed to the launched app process on simulator runtime

env.description: Environment variables to pass to the launched app (SIMCTL_CHILD_ prefix added automatically)

rawToolsCapture.name: stop_app_sim
rawToolsCapture.description: Stop sim app.

rawToolsCapture.name: record_sim_video
rawToolsCapture.description: Record sim video.

evidence.description: Non-actionable semantic evidence rows in role|label|value|identifier format. These rows intentionally omit element refs.

rawToolsCapture.description: Extract bundle id from .app.

rawToolsCapture.description: Capture screenshot.

returnFormat.description: Return image path or base64 data (path|base64)

evidence.description: Non-actionable semantic evidence rows in role|label|value|identifier format. These rows intentionally omit element refs.

rawToolsCapture.description: Capture a semantic rs/1 runtime UI snapshot with elementRef targets. Observe once, use tap for one target or batch for multiple same-screen targets, and refresh after navigation, scrolling, sheet changes, or obvious layout changes.

sinceScreenHash.description: Return an unchanged response when the current screen hash matches this value

evidence.description: Non-actionable semantic evidence rows in role|label|value|identifier format. These rows intentionally omit element refs.

rawToolsCapture.description: Show per-target code coverage from an xcresult bundle.

target.description: Filter results to a specific target name

showFiles.description: When true, include per-file coverage breakdown under each target

rawToolsCapture.name: get_file_coverage
rawToolsCapture.description: Show function-level coverage and uncovered line ranges for a specific file.

file.description: Source file name or path to inspect

showLines.description: When true, include uncovered line ranges from the archive
